akhfash:1-2.t: He said ﴿عِوَجَا﴾ ﴿قَيِّماً﴾, i.e. He sent down upon His servant the Book upright (قَيِّما) and did not put any crookedness (عِوَجا) in it.

akhfash:3-3.t: And He said ﴿مَّاكِثِينَ فِيهِ أَبَداً﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) depending on ﴿أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْراً حَسَناً﴾ [2].

akhfash:5-5.t:
And He said ﴿كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةً﴾ because it has the meaning of "how great a word it is!" (أكْبِرْ بِها كَلِمَةً), just as He said ﴿وَسَآءَتْ مُرْتَفَقاً﴾. In the accusative it is like the poet's words [in the kāmil metre; this is poetic witness no. 244]:
وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ إِذْ الرِّياحُ تَرَوَّحَت * هَدَجَ الرِّئالِ تَكُبُّهُنَّ شمَالا
(You knew, when the winds blew in the evening, driving along the young ostriches in their shuffling gait, the north wind overturning them.)
i.e. the winds overturn them as a north wind. So it is as though He said: "That word is great". Some put "the word" (الكلمة) in the nominative, because it is the thing that is great.

akhfash:6-6.t: As for His word ﴿أَسَفاً﴾, it is really ﴿فَلَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ﴾ ﴿أَسَفَاً﴾ (perhaps you will destroy yourself out of grief).

akhfash:11-11.t: And He said ﴿سِنِينَ عَدَداً﴾, i.e. "We count them in number" (نَعُدُّها عَدَدا).

akhfash:16-16.t: And He said ﴿ مِّنْ أَمْرِكُمْ مِّرْفَقاً﴾, i.e. something they make use of, like "المِقْطَع" (a cutting tool). And ﴿مَرْفِقَاَ﴾: he made it a noun like "المَسْجِد" (the mosque), or it may be a dialect in which they say "رَفَقَ" "يَرْفُقُ". And if you wish, ﴿مَرْفَقَا﴾, meaning "رِفْقاً" (gentleness); but it has not been read that way.

akhfash:17-17.t: And He said ﴿تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ﴾: ﴿ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ﴾ is accusative (manṣūb) as an adverbial (ẓarf).

akhfash:18-18.t: And He said ﴿أَيْقَاظاً﴾: its singular is "اليَقِظُ" (awake); as for "اليَقْظانُ", its plural is "اليِقَاظُ".

akhfash:19-19.t: And He said ﴿فَلْيَنْظُرْ أَيُّهَآ أَزْكَىٰ طَعَاماً﴾: ﴿فَلْيَنْظُرْ﴾ was not made to act on ﴿أيّ﴾ because it is one of the verbs after which an interrogative particle can come; you say: "انْظُرْ أَزَيْدٌ أَكْرَمُ أَمْ عَمْرٌو" (see whether Zayd is nobler or ʿAmr).

akhfash:22-22.t: And He said ﴿مَّا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلاَّ قَلِيلٌ﴾, i.e. none of the people knows them except a few; and the few know them.

akhfash:24-24.t: And He said ﴿إِلاَّ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ﴾, i.e. "unless you say: 'if Allah wills'"; this sufficed in place of that. Likewise, when speech becomes long, something like an allusion suffices in it, because part of it points to the rest.

akhfash:25-25.t: And He said ﴿ثَلاثَ مِئَةٍ سِنِينَ﴾ as a badal (substitute) for ﴿ثَلاثَ﴾ and for "المِئَة", i.e. "they stayed three hundred". If "the years" are an explanation of "the hundred" it is genitive; if it is an explanation of "the three" it is accusative.

akhfash:26-26.t: And He said ﴿أَبْصِرْ بِهِ وَأَسْمِعْ﴾, i.e. "how well He sees and how well He hears!", just as you say: "أَكْرِمْ بِهِ", i.e. "how noble he is!". That is because the Arabs say: "يا أَمَةَ اللهِ أَكْرِمْ بِزَيْدٍ" (O servant-woman of Allah, how noble is Zayd!), and this has the meaning of "how noble he is!"; if he were ordering her to do something he would have said "أَكْرِمِي زَيْداً" (honour Zayd, feminine).

akhfash:28-28.t: And He said ﴿وَلاَ تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ﴾, i.e. the two eyes, so let them not pass beyond (them).

akhfash:29-29.t: And He said ﴿وَقُلِ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ﴾, i.e. say: "It is the truth". And His word ﴿وَسَآءَتْ مُرْتَفَقاً﴾, i.e. and evil is the abode as a resting place.

akhfash:30-30.t: And He said ﴿إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّالِحَاتِ إِنَّا لاَ نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلاً﴾, because when He said ﴿لاَ نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلاً﴾ it had the meaning of "We do not let their rewards be lost, because they are among those who did good deeds".

akhfash:32-34.t:
And His word ﴿وَٱضْرِبْ لهُمْ مَّثَلاً رَّجُلَيْنِ﴾, and He said ﴿وَكَانَ لَهُ ثَمَرٌ﴾: He mentioned the two men in the meaning, and one of them had fruit, so the one sufficed for the other.
And He said ﴿كِلْتَا ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ آتَتْ أُكُلَهَا﴾: He made the verb singular and did not say "آتتا" (dual), because He made it agree with the word ﴿كِلْتَا﴾ in its form. Had He made it agree with the meaning of ﴿كِلْتَا﴾, He would have said "آتَتَا".

akhfash:50-50.t:
And He said ﴿فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِ﴾: He means "concerning the rejection of his Lord's command", like the Arabs' saying "أُتْخِمَ عَنِ الطَّعامِ" (he got indigestion from food), i.e. from eating it he got indigestion; and when he rejected this command, he transgressed.
And He said ﴿بِئْسَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ بَدَلاً﴾, just as you say: "بِئْسَ فِي الدّارِ رَجُلا" (how evil a man is in the house!).

akhfash:52-52.t: And He said ﴿مَّوْبِقاً﴾, like ﴿مَّوْعِداً﴾, from "وَبَقَ" "يَبِقُ" (to perish); and you say "أَوْبَقْتُهُ حتى وَبَقَ" (I destroyed him until he perished).

akhfash:55-55.t: And He said ﴿إِلاَّ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ﴾, because "أَنْ" is in the position of a noun: "except the coming of the practice of the ancients".

akhfash:58-58.t: And He said ﴿مَوْئِلاٍ﴾, from "وَأَلَ" "يَئِلُ" "وَأْلاً" (to seek refuge).

akhfash:59-59.t: And He said ﴿وَتِلْكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُواْ﴾, meaning their people, just as He said ﴿ وَسْئَلِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ﴾. He did not bring (the pronoun) according to the word "القُرَى" (the towns) but made the wording run on the people, while in "القَرْية" He made the wording run on the town itself, up to His word ﴿ٱلَّتِي كُنَّا فِيهَا﴾. He said ﴿أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ﴾ and did not say "أهْلَكْناهَا", construing it on the people, just as one says "وجاءَتْ تميمُ" (Tamīm came, with a feminine verb), making the verb belong to "بَنِي تَميم" (the Banū Tamīm) and not to "تَمِيم". Had he done that, he would have said "جاءَ تَميم". This is not good in such a case, because in such a place he means something other than Tamīm, so he made it a noun; and when it became defective, it could not bear having everything before it omitted — meaning the tāʾ of "جاءَتْ" together with "بني" — while leaving the verb as it was, to indicate that something had been omitted before "تَمِيم".

akhfash:60-60.t:
And He said ﴿لاۤ أَبْرَحُ﴾, i.e. "I will not cease". The poet said [in the ṭawīl metre; this is poetic witness no. 245]:
وَمَا بَرِحُوا حتَّى تَهادَتْ نِساؤُهُمْ * بَبَطْحاءِ ذي قارٍ عيابَ اللَّطاَئِمِ
(They did not cease until their women passed among themselves, in the valley of Dhū Qār, the bags of the musk-caravans.)
i.e. "they did not cease".

akhfash:62-62.t: And He said ﴿آتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا﴾: if you wish, you make it from "آتَى الغداءَ" (he brought the morning meal), or "أَئيِةِ", just as you say "ذَهَبَ" (he went) and "أَذْهَبْتُهُ" (I made him go); and if you wish, from "أَعْطى" (to give). And this is frequent.

akhfash:74-74.t: And He said ﴿حَتَّىٰ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلاَماً فَقَتَلَهُ﴾: He said ﴿فَقَتَلَهُ﴾ (with fa) because the meeting was the cause of the killing.

akhfash:80-80.t: As for ﴿فَخَشِينَآ﴾, its meaning is "We disliked", because Allah does not fear. In some readings it is ﴿فَخَافَ رَبُّكَ﴾. It is like "خِفْتُ الرَّجُلَيْنِ أَنْ يَقُولا" (I feared the two men would say), where he does not fear that any more than that he dislikes it for them.

akhfash:94-94.t: And He said ﴿يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ﴾: he used hamza and made the alif part of the root, making "يأجوج" of the pattern "يَفْعُول" and "مأجوج" [of the pattern] "مَفْعُول". The one who does not use hamza makes both alifs extra and makes them from different verbs, making "يَاجُوج" from "يَجَجْتُ" and مَاجُوج from "مَجَجْتُ".

akhfash:95-95.t: And He said ﴿مَا مَكَّنِّي فِيهِ رَبِّي خَيْرٌ﴾: he assimilated (the nūns) and put ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ in the nominative, because ﴿مَا مَكَّنِّي﴾ is a noun beginning a new clause.

akhfash:97-97.t: And He said ﴿فَمَا ٱسْطَاعُوۤاْ﴾ because a dialect of the Arabs says "اِسْطاعَ" "يَسْطيِع", meaning by it "اِسْتَطاع" "يَستطيع" (to be able), but they omitted the tāʾ when it came together with the ṭāʾ, because their place of articulation is the same. Some said "اِسْتاعَ", omitting the ṭāʾ for that reason. Some said "أَسْطاع" "يُسْطِيع", making it with the disjunctive hamza, as though it were "أَطَاعَ" "يُطِيع", and making the sīn a compensation for the vowellessness of the yāʾ.

akhfash:98-98.t: And He said ﴿هَـٰذَا رَحْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّي﴾, i.e. this barrier is a mercy from my Lord.

akhfash:102-102.t:
And He said ﴿أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوۤاْ أَن يَتَّخِذُواْ عِبَادِي﴾: He made it the ﴿أَنْ﴾ that operates on verbs, so "حَسِبُوا" (they reckoned) was satisfied with it, just as He said ﴿إِن ظَنَّآ أَن يُقِيمَا﴾ and ﴿مَآ أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَـٰذِهِ﴾. Here it was satisfied with a single object, because the meaning of ﴿مَا أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ﴾ is: "I do not think it will perish".
Some read ﴿أَفَحَسْبُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوۤاْ أَن يَتَّخِذُواْ عِبَادِي﴾, meaning: "Is that sufficient for them?"

akhfash:103-103.t: And He said ﴿بِٱلأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَالاً﴾: because when He put the alif-lām and the nūn on ﴿الأَخْسَرِينَ﴾, it could not reach the iḍāfa (genitive construct), and "the deeds" belong to ﴿الأَخْسَرِينَ﴾; for that reason it is accusative.

akhfash:107-107.t: And He said ﴿جَنَّاتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلاً﴾: "النُزُلُ" (hospitality) is from the alighting of some people with others. As for "النَزَلُ", it is "الرَيْعُ" (increase, yield); you say: "ما لِطَعَامِهِم نَزَلٌ" (their food has no yield) and "ما وَجَدْنَا عِنْدَهُمْ نَزَلا" (we found no yield with them).

akhfash:109-109.t: And He said ﴿قُل لَّوْ كَانَ ٱلْبَحْرُ مِدَاداً لِّكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّي﴾: He means "ink with which to write". ﴿لَنَفِدَ ٱلْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَاتُ رَبِّي وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ مَدَداً﴾: He means "a supply for you". Some read ﴿مِدَادَا﴾ (ink) with which you write. By "المداد" here he means that it is a supply for the ink, with which it is replenished so as to be with it.

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the kāf is a particle of comparison and a preposition, and ذا is a demonstrative; the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿بَعَثْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِيَتَسائَلُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the lām and what follows it are attached to بعثناهم. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to يتساءلوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قالَ قائِلٌ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: the two are attached to قائل. ﴿كَمْ﴾: an interrogative noun, an adverb of time. ﴿لَبِثْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَبِثْنا﴾: a past verb [Translator's note: the source has «ماص», a misprint for «ماض» (past verb).] and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿يَوْماً﴾: an adverb of time attached to لبثنا. ﴿أَوْ بَعْضَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative, and the two are attached to أعلم. ﴿لَبِثْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَابْعَثُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَحَدَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِوَرِقِكُمْ﴾: the two are attached to ابعثوا. ﴿هذِهِ﴾: the hāʾ [Translator's note: the source writes «الها».] is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, a naʿt of ورقكم. ﴿إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ﴾: the two are attached to ابعثوا. ﴿فَلْيَنْظُرْ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, the lām is the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَيُّها﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَزْكى﴾: khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿طَعاماً﴾: tamyīz (specification); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿فَلْيَأْتِكُمْ﴾: its i'rab is like the i'rab of فلينظر, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِرِزْقٍ﴾: the two are attached to يأتكم. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of رزق. ﴿وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ﴾: its i'rab is like فلينظر. ﴿وَلا يُشْعِرَنَّ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and لا is prohibitive; an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾: the two are attached to يشعرنّ. ﴿أَحَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:20-21.t: ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿إِنْ يَظْهَرُوا﴾: إن is conditional, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to يظهروا. ﴿يَرْجُمُوكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿أَوْ يُعِيدُوكُمْ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes. ﴿فِي مِلَّتِهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to يعيدوكم. ﴿وَلَنْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and لن is a particle of the accusative. ﴿تُفْلِحُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of response. ﴿أَبَداً﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time attached to تفلحوا. ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾: see the i'rab of the previous verse. ﴿أَعْثَرْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to أعثرنا. ﴿لِيَعْلَمُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the lām and what follows it are attached to أعثرنا, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَنَّ وَعْدَ﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); anna and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of يعلموا. ﴿حَقٌّ﴾: khabar (predicate) of anna. ﴿وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ﴾: anna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا رَيْبَ فِيها﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation and ريب is its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is the khabar of anna. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached to أعثرنا. ﴿يَتَنازَعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ أَمْرَهُمْ﴾: بينهم is an adverb of place, and أمرهم is muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: so in the source; أَمْرَهُمْ is accusative and is ordinarily parsed as mafʿūl bihi of يتنازعون.], and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَقالُوا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ابْنُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to ابنوا. ﴿بُنْياناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَبُّهُمْ أَعْلَمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is parenthetical. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to أعلم. ﴿قالَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb, and the relative noun is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿غَلَبُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلى أَمْرِهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to غلبوا. ﴿لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to نتخذ. ﴿مَسْجِداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying.

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿سَيَقُولُونَ﴾: the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿ثَلاثَةٌ﴾: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم"; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿رابِعُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ثلاثة. ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ خَمْسَةٌ سادِسُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes. ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and the imperfect verb is nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿سَبْعَةٌ﴾: khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هم". ﴿وَثامِنُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِعِدَّتِهِمْ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أعلم; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿ما يَعْلَمُهُمْ﴾: ما is negative, and an imperfect verb and its fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلٌ﴾: a postponed fāʿil. ﴿فَلا تُمارِ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and لا is prohibitive; تمار is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِيهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to تمار. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿مِراءً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿ظاهِراً﴾: a naʿt. ﴿وَلا تَسْتَفْتِ﴾: like the preceding one. ﴿فِيهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿أَحَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:23-25.t: ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَقُولَنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِشَيْءٍ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to تقولن. ﴿إِنِّي فاعِلٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of فاعل; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿غَداً﴾: an adverb of time attached to فاعل. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿يَشاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاذْكُرْ رَبَّكَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; ربك is mafʿūl bihi and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِذا نَسِيتَ﴾: إذا is an adverb of time attached to اذكر, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَسى﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, one of the verbs of hope; its noun is omitted. ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿يَهْدِيَنِ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: a postponed fāʿil, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِأَقْرَبَ﴾: the two are attached to يهدين. ﴿مِنْ هذا﴾: the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh) and ذا is a demonstrative; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أقرب. ﴿رَشَداً﴾: tamyīz (specification); the clause is the khabar of عسى. ﴿وَلَبِثُوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي كَهْفِهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to لبثوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثَلاثَ مِائَةٍ﴾: ثلاث is an adverb of time attached to لبثوا. ﴿مِائَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سِنِينَ﴾: badal (substitute) of ثلاث; its position is accusative like it, marked with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿وَازْدَادُوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿تِسْعاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:26-27.t: ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and أعلم is khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أعلم. ﴿لَبِثُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَهُ غَيْبُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the fronted, omitted khabar. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات. ﴿أَبْصِرْ﴾: for wonder (taʿajjub); a past verb that comes in the form of the imperative; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and the hāʾ is the fāʿil of أبصر. ﴿وَأَسْمِعْ﴾: conjoined to أبصر; the speech is the object of the saying. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾: the two are attached to the omitted khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant preposition. ﴿وَلِيٍّ﴾: a noun genitive in form and nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and لا is negative. ﴿يُشْرِكُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي حُكْمِهِ﴾: the two are attached to يشرك, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَحَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَاتْلُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾: a relative, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُوحِيَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: the two are attached to أوحي. ﴿مِنْ كِتابِ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation, operating as inna operates. ﴿مُبَدِّلَ﴾: its noun. ﴿لِكَلِماتِهِ﴾: the two are attached to the omitted khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَلَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive and لن is a particle governing the accusative. ﴿تَجِدَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb), its fāʿil latent. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾: the two are attached to تجد, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُلْتَحَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿وَاصْبِرْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿نَفْسَكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَعَ﴾: an adverb of place attached (mutaʿalliq) to اصبر. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿رَبَّهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْغَداةِ﴾: the two are attached to يدعون. ﴿وَالْعَشِيِّ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الغداة. ﴿يُرِيدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿وَجْهَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَعْدُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter. ﴿عَيْناكَ﴾: fāʿil, nominative by the alif because it is dual, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾: the two are attached to تعد. ﴿تُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿زِينَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: a naʿt (adjective), genitive by an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تُطِعْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by لا, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَغْفَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿قَلْبَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَنْ ذِكْرِنا﴾: the two are attached to أغفلنا. ﴿وَاتَّبَعَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿هَواهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative by an implied fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَكانَ أَمْرُهُ فُرُطاً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:29-30.t: ﴿وَقُلِ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the khabar (predicate), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and من is a conditional noun governing the jussive, mubtadaʾ. ﴿شاءَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فَلْيُؤْمِنْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, the lām is the lām of command, and يؤمن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the condition are in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَمَنْ شاءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿أَعْتَدْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the clause إنا etc. is an explanation of cause (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿لِلظَّالِمِينَ﴾: the two are attached to أعتدنا. ﴿ناراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَحاطَ بِهِمْ سُرادِقُها﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أحاط, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of نارا. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive and إن is conditional. ﴿يَسْتَغِيثُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُغاثُوا﴾: a passive imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis, by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿بِماءٍ﴾: the two are attached to يغاثوا. ﴿كَالْمُهْلِ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of ماء. ﴿يَشْوِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْوُجُوهَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a second naʿt of ماء. ﴿بِئْسَ﴾: a past verb for expressing blame. ﴿الشَّرابُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَساءَتْ﴾: a past verb for expressing blame, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مُرْتَفَقاً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: inna, and the relative noun is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to آمنوا. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna, and نا is its noun; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿لا نُضِيعُ﴾: لا is negative; نضيع is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَجْرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of إنا. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَحْسَنَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is omitted [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere such a fāʿil is described as latent (mustatir).]. ﴿عَمَلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:31-32.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is for address. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿جَنَّاتُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿عَدْنٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَجْرِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness. ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ﴾: the two are attached to تجري, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar. ﴿يُحَلَّوْنَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿فِيها﴾: the two are attached to يحلون. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a preposition. ﴿أَساوِرَ﴾: a genitive noun, and the two are attached to a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ ذَهَبٍ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of أساور; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَلْبَسُونَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يحلّون; an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿ثِياباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خُضْراً﴾: a naʿt. ﴿مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt. ﴿وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ﴾: conjoined to سندس. ﴿مُتَّكِئِينَ﴾: ḥāl. ﴿فِيها﴾: the two are attached to متكئين. ﴿عَلَى الْأَرائِكِ﴾: the two are attached to متكئين. ﴿نِعْمَ﴾: a past verb for expressing praise. ﴿الثَّوابُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَحَسُنَتْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مُرْتَفَقاً﴾: tamyīz (specification); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاضْرِبْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: the two are attached to اضرب. ﴿مَثَلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَجُلَيْنِ﴾: badal (substitute) of مثلا, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is dual. ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لِأَحَدِهِما﴾: the two are attached to جعلنا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَنَّتَيْنِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ because it is dual. ﴿مِنْ أَعْنابٍ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of جنتين. ﴿وَحَفَفْناهُما﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِنَخْلٍ﴾: the two are attached to حففناهما. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾: an adverb of place attached to جعلنا. ﴿زَرْعاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:33-35.t: ﴿كِلْتَا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because it is a maqṣūr noun. ﴿الْجَنَّتَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is dual; the clause is resumptive. ﴿آتَتْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿أُكُلَها﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and لم governs the jussive. ﴿تَظْلِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil latent. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to تظلم. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَفَجَّرْنا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿خِلالَهُما﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَهَراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَكانَ لَهُ ثَمَرٌ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and kāna and its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَقالَ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِصاحِبِهِ﴾: the two are attached to قال. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُحاوِرُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَنَا أَكْثَرُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنْكَ﴾: the two are attached to أكثر. ﴿مالًا﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَأَعَزُّ نَفَراً﴾: conjoined to the preceding, and its i'rab is like its i'rab. ﴿وَدَخَلَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and دخل is a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿جَنَّتَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَهُوَ ظالِمٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لِنَفْسِهِ﴾: the two are attached to ظالم. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿أَظُنُّ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿تَبِيدَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an; an and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of ظن. ﴿هذِهِ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as fāʿil, and the hāʾ [Translator's note: the source writes «الها».] is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿أَبَداً﴾: an adverb of time attached to تبيد.

daas-irab:36-38.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and ما is negative. ﴿أَظُنُّ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿السَّاعَةَ قائِمَةً﴾: the two objects of أظن; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾: the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and إن is a conditional particle governing the jussive. ﴿رُدِدْتُ﴾: a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause has no grammatical position because it is initial. ﴿إِلى رَبِّي﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to رددت, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَأَجِدَنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿خَيْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْها﴾: the two are attached to خيرا. ﴿مُنْقَلَباً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿قالَ لَهُ صاحِبُهُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قال, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial and هو is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يُحاوِرُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿أَكَفَرْتَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِالَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, and the two are attached to كفرت. ﴿خَلَقَكَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ تُرابٍ﴾: the two are attached to خلقك. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: conjunctive. ﴿مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to من تراب. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: conjunctive. ﴿سَوَّاكَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَجُلًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لكِنَّا﴾: composed of لكن and أنا; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk) and أنا is mubtadaʾ, and its clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ﴾: a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, a third mubtadaʾ. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: khabar, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause هو الله ربي is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أنا. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and لا is negative. ﴿أُشْرِكُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِرَبِّي﴾: the two are attached to أشرك, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَحَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:39-41.t: ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and لولا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قُلْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾: a relative, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) omitted, its implied form being "ما شاء الله كائن"; it is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لا قُوَّةَ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation and قوة is its noun. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ; the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿تَرَنِ﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنَا﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. ﴿أَقَلَّ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْكَ﴾: the two are attached to أقل. ﴿مالًا﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَوَلَداً﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to مالا. ﴿فَعَسى﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and عسى is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: the noun of عسى, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause of عسى is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿يُؤْتِيَنِ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb); the nūn is the nūn of protection and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; an and what follows it are the khabar of عسى. ﴿خَيْراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ جَنَّتِكَ﴾: the two are attached to خيرا. ﴿وَيُرْسِلَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْها﴾: the two are attached to يرسل. ﴿حُسْباناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of حسبانا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَتُصْبِحَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunctive fāʾ, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿صَعِيداً﴾: khabar. ﴿زَلَقاً﴾: a naʿt. ﴿أَوْ﴾: conjunctive. ﴿يُصْبِحَ ماؤُها غَوْراً﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb, its noun and its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَلَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive and لن is a particle governing the accusative. ﴿تَسْتَطِيعَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by لن, its fāʿil latent. ﴿لَهُ﴾: the two are attached to طلبا. ﴿طَلَباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:42-44.t: ﴿وَأُحِيطَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a passive past verb whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِثَمَرِهِ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أحيط; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأَصْبَحَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is omitted; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُقَلِّبُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أصبح. ﴿كَفَّيْهِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is dual, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلى ما﴾: ما is a relative, and the two are attached to يقلب. ﴿أَنْفَقَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِيها﴾: the two are attached to أنفق; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَهِيَ خاوِيَةٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلى عُرُوشِها﴾: the two are attached to خاوية, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَقُولُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿يا﴾: a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿لَيْتَنِي﴾: ليت, the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is its noun; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَمْ﴾: a particle of negation, the jussive and conversion (qalb). ﴿أُشْرِكْ﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil latent. ﴿بِرَبِّي﴾: the two are attached to أشرك. ﴿أَحَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of ليت. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and لم governs the jussive. ﴿تَكُنْ﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾: the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿فِئَةٌ﴾: its postponed noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَنْصُرُونَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of فئة. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: the two are attached to ينصرونه. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and ما is negative. ﴿كانَ مُنْتَصِراً﴾: kāna and its khabar, its noun omitted; the clause is conjoined. ﴿هُنالِكَ﴾: هنا is a demonstrative, accusative as an adverb of place, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿الْوَلايَةُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the two are attached to الولاية; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾: a naʿt. ﴿هُوَ خَيْرٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ثَواباً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَخَيْرٌ عُقْباً﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to خير ثوابا.

daas-irab:45-46.t: ﴿وَاضْرِبْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to اضرب. ﴿مَثَلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: a naʿt (adjective), genitive by an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿كَماءٍ﴾: the two are attached to اضرب. ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a naʿt of ماء. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: the two are attached to أنزلناه. ﴿فَاخْتَلَطَ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿بِهِ﴾: the two are attached to اختلط. ﴿نَباتُ﴾: the fāʿil of اختلط. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَصْبَحَ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿هَشِيماً﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿تَذْرُوهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied ḍamma on the wāw owing to heaviness, and the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الرِّياحُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is a second khabar of أصبح. وكان: the wāw is resumptive; كان is an incomplete past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾: the two are attached to مقتدرا; the clause is resumptive. [Translator's note: in the source the word وكان is not set in Quranic brackets, and no analysis is given for ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ or ﴿مُقْتَدِراً﴾ (the khabar of كان).] ﴿الْمالُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَالْبَنُونَ﴾: conjoined, with the wāw because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿زِينَةُ﴾: khabar. ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: a naʿt, genitive by an implied kasra on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالْباقِياتُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and الباقيات is mubtadaʾ. ﴿الصَّالِحاتُ﴾: a naʿt. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to خير. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثَواباً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَخَيْرٌ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to خير. ﴿أَمَلًا﴾: tamyīz.

daas-irab:47-48.t:
[Translator's note: from ﴿وَعُرِضُوا﴾ onward the Quranic word markers in the source text are corrupted (brackets and initial letters lost); the words are restored below from the text of verse 48.]
﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; يوم is an adverb of time attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر". ﴿نُسَيِّرُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is omitted. ﴿الْجِبالَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَتَرَى﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بارِزَةً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَحَشَرْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَلَمْ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive and لم governs the jussive. ﴿نُغادِرْ﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿أَحَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَعُرِضُوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a passive past verb; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى رَبِّكَ﴾: the two are attached to عرضوا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿صَفًّا﴾: ḥāl. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جِئْتُمُونا﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition and ما is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿خَلَقْناكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; ما and what follows it are attached to جئتمونا. ﴿أَوَّلَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to خلقناكم. ﴿مَرَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿زَعَمْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أن﴾: lightened from أنّ, and its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). ﴿لن﴾: a particle governing the accusative. ﴿نَجْعَلَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb), its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of an. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: the two are attached to نجعل. ﴿مَوْعِداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:49-50.t: ﴿وَوُضِعَ الْكِتابُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَتَرَى﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿مُشْفِقِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: ما is a relative, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to مشفقين. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا﴾: a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿وَيْلَتَنا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) that has no verb. ﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِهذَا﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by the lām; the two are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate), and the hāʾ is for drawing attention. ﴿الْكِتابُ﴾: badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لا يُغادِرُ﴾: لا is negative; يغادر is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿صَغِيرَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا كَبِيرَةً﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَحْصاها﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of صغيرة. ﴿وَوَجَدُوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَمِلُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿حاضِراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and لا is negative. ﴿يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَحَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذ is an adverb of time attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر". ﴿قُلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِلْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: the two are attached to قلنا. ﴿اسْجُدُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لِآدَمَ﴾: the two are attached to اسجدوا, and آدم is genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿فَسَجَدُوا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿إِبْلِيسَ﴾: excepted by إلا, accusative. ﴿كانَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ﴾: kāna and its omitted noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿فَفَسَقَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَنْ أَمْرِ﴾: the two are attached to فسق. ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its first object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَذُرِّيَّتَهُ﴾: conjoined to the hāʾ. ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾: second object. ﴿مِنْ دُونِي﴾: the two are attached to أولياء. ﴿وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is a ḥāl, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عدو. ﴿بِئْسَ﴾: a past verb for expressing blame, its fāʿil latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلظَّالِمِينَ﴾: the two are attached to بدلا. ﴿بَدَلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification).

daas-irab:51-52.t: ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿أَشْهَدْتُهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. ﴿خَلْقَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to خلق [Translator's note: so in the source; الأرض is genitive and is conjoined to السماوات.]. ﴿وَلا خَلْقَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and ما is negative. ﴿كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذَ﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْمُضِلِّينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, of the type in which the active participle is annexed to its object, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿عَضُداً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of متخذ. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and يوم is an adverb of time attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted verb اذكر. ﴿يَقُولُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نادُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿شُرَكائِيَ﴾: its mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, whose appearance is prevented by the place being occupied with the vowel suited to the yāʾ; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, a naʿt (adjective) or badal (substitute) of شركائي, in the position of the accusative like it. ﴿زَعَمْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَدَعَوْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَلَمْ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive and لم governs the jussive. ﴿يَسْتَجِيبُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb attached to جعلنا. ﴿مَوْبِقاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:53-55.t: ﴿وَرَأَى الْمُجْرِمُونَ النَّارَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَظَنُّوا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ مُواقِعُوها﴾: anna, its noun and its khabar (predicate), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the interpreted maṣdar formed from anna and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of ظن. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and لم governs the jussive. ﴿يَجِدُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَنْها﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to يجدوا. ﴿مَصْرِفاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿صَرَّفْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي هذَا﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, and the two are attached to صرفنا. ﴿الْقُرْآنِ﴾: badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾: the two are attached to صرفنا. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مَثَلٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position because it occurs as the response to an oath. ﴿وَكانَ الْإِنْسانُ أَكْثَرَ﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَدَلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive and ما is negative. ﴿مَنَعَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوا﴾: أن is negative [Translator's note: so in the source («أن نافية»); أن here governs the accusative and forms a maṣdar, as the rest of the analysis shows.], and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of منع. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَهُمُ الْهُدى﴾: a past verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّهُمْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿تَأْتِيَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿سُنَّةُ﴾: a postponed fāʿil. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿أَوْ﴾: conjunctive. ﴿يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذابُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is its fronted object and العذاب is its fāʿil. ﴿قُبُلًا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:56-57.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive and ما is negative. ﴿نُرْسِلُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مُبَشِّرِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمُنْذِرِينَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to مبشرين. ﴿وَيُجادِلُ الَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِالْباطِلِ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to يجادل. ﴿لِيُدْحِضُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the lām and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar, are attached to يجادل. ﴿بِهِ﴾: the two are attached to يدحضوا. ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَاتَّخَذُوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿آياتِي﴾: its first object, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and ما is a relative noun conjoined to آياتي. ﴿أُنْذِرُوا﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿هُزُواً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and من is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾: من is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by من, and the two are attached to أظلم. ﴿ذُكِّرَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِآياتِ﴾: the two are attached to ذكر. ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَعْرَضَ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَنْها﴾: the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَنَسِيَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾: a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قَدَّمَتْ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿يَداهُ﴾: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) by the alif because it is dual, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is an explanation of cause (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿جَعَلْنا عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and أكنة is its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أكنة, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿يَفْقَهُوهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿وَفِي آذانِهِمْ وَقْراً﴾: conjoined to قلوبهم. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive and إن is conditional. ﴿تَدْعُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), by the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَى الْهُدى﴾: the two are attached to تدعهم. ﴿فَلَنْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and لن is a particle governing the accusative. ﴿يَهْتَدُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by لن, by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of response. ﴿أَبَداً﴾: an adverb of time attached to يهتدوا.

daas-irab:58-60.t: ﴿وَرَبُّكَ الْغَفُورُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is initial. ﴿ذُو﴾: a second khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw. ﴿الرَّحْمَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿يُؤاخِذُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is its object; the clause is initial. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to يؤاخذهم. ﴿كَسَبُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَعَجَّلَ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to لو, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿لَهُمُ﴾: the two are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿مَوْعِدٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿يَجِدُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of موعد. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾: the two are attached to يجدوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَوْئِلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَتِلْكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿الْقُرى﴾: badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), and its clause is resumptive. ﴿أَهْلَكْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar. ﴿لَمَّا﴾: the temporal لمّا (al-ẓarfiyya al-ḥīniyya). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لِمَهْلِكِهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to جعلنا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَوْعِداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذ is an adverb attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر"; it is resumptive. ﴿قالَ مُوسى﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, nominative by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِفَتاهُ﴾: فتاه is genitive (majrūr) by an implied kasra on the alif owing to impossibility, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the two are attached to قال. ﴿لا أَبْرَحُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb whose noun is omitted; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿أَبْلُغَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after حتى; حتى and what follows it are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "أسير"; the fāʿil of أبلغ is latent. ﴿مَجْمَعَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْبَحْرَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, by the yāʾ. ﴿أَوْ﴾: conjunctive. ﴿أَمْضِيَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أبلغ, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿حُقُباً﴾: an adverb of time; the two [Translator's note: so in the source («متعلقان»), though only a single word is meant.] are attached to أمضي.

daas-irab:61-63.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; an adverb of time meaning "when" (ḥīna). ﴿بَلَغا﴾: a past verb, and the alif is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَجْمَعَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَيْنِهِما﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَسِيا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿حُوتَهُما﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿فَاتَّخَذَ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿سَبِيلَهُ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to اتخذ. ﴿سَرَباً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the temporal لمّا (al-ẓarfiyya al-ḥīniyya). ﴿جاوَزا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the response to لما. ﴿لِفَتاهُ﴾: the two are attached to قال. ﴿آتِنا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent and نا is its first object. ﴿غَداءَنا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿لَقِينا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to an oath. ﴿مِنْ سَفَرِنا﴾: the two are attached to لقينا, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هذا﴾: the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh); ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive, a naʿt (adjective) of سفر. ﴿نَصَباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَرَأَيْتَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil; it means "tell me", and its two objects are omitted; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿أَوَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ﴾: the two are attached to أوينا. ﴿فَإِنِّي﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and inna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is parenthetical and ما is negative. ﴿أَنْسانِيهُ﴾: a past verb; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi and the hāʾ is the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is parenthetical. ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿أَذْكُرَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb); the hāʾ is its object and its fāʿil is latent; the first maṣdar [Translator's note: so in the source («المصدر الأول»), probably for «المصدر المؤول», the interpreted maṣdar.] is a badal (substitute) of the hāʾ in أنسانيه. ﴿وَاتَّخَذَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿سَبِيلَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾: the two are attached to اتخذ. ﴿عَجَباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:64-67.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿ما﴾: a relative, in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كُنَّا﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿نَبْغِ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ that is dropped in the Muṣḥaf; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿فَارْتَدَّا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى آثارِهِما﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ارتدا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قَصَصاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿فَوَجَدا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَبْداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ عِبادِنا﴾: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of عبد; the clause is conjoined. ﴿آتَيْناهُ رَحْمَةً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِنا﴾: the two are attached to رحمة, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a second naʿt of رحمة [Translator's note: so in the source.]. ﴿وَعَلَّمْناهُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنَّا﴾: the two are attached to علمناه, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِلْماً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿قالَ لَهُ مُوسى﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قال; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle. ﴿أَتَّبِعُكَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿عَلى﴾: a preposition. ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿تُعَلِّمَنِ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb); the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; an and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar, are in the position of the genitive, and the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِمَّا﴾: originally the preposition من and the relative ما; the two are attached to علمت. ﴿عُلِّمْتَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿رُشْداً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لَنْ﴾: a particle governing the accusative. ﴿تَسْتَطِيعَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مَعِيَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to تستطيع, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿صَبْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:68-70.t: ﴿وَكَيْفَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَصْبِرُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلى﴾: a preposition. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to تصبر. ﴿لَمْ﴾: a particle of negation, the jussive and conversion (qalb). ﴿تُحِطْ﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِهِ﴾: the two are attached to تحط. ﴿خُبْراً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَتَجِدُنِي﴾: the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb in the nominative; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is in the position of the accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿صابِراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and لا is negative. ﴿أَعْصِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَكَ﴾: the two are attached to أعصي. ﴿أَمْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) clause is omitted, what precedes it pointing to it. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فَإِنِ اتَّبَعْتَنِي﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and إن is conditional, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the nūn is the nūn of protection and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and لا is prohibitive, governing the jussive. ﴿تَسْئَلْنِي﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive; the yāʾ is its object, the nūn is the nūn of protection, and its fāʿil is "أنت". ﴿عَنْ شَيْءٍ﴾: the two are attached to the verb. ﴿حَتَّى أُحْدِثَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive. ﴿لَكَ﴾: the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿ذِكْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:71-73.t: ﴿فَانْطَلَقا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; انطلقا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the alif of the dual is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb for future time, or a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿رَكِبا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause ركبا is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿فِي السَّفِينَةِ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ركبا. ﴿خَرَقَها﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to إذا. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَخَرَقْتَها﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; خرقتها is a past verb, the tāʾ is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِتُغْرِقَ﴾: the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَهْلَها﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to the omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جِئْتَ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِمْراً﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of شيئا. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and لم is a particle of the jussive, negation and conversion (qalb). ﴿أَقُلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, its fāʿil latent. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿لَنْ﴾: a particle governing the accusative. ﴿تَسْتَطِيعَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَعِيَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to تستطيع, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿صَبْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا تُؤاخِذْنِي﴾: لا is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive لا; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), the fāʿil is latent and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the two are attached to تؤاخذني. ﴿نَسِيتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تُرْهِقْنِي﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive; the nūn is the nūn of protection, its fāʿil is latent and the yāʾ is its object. ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِي﴾: the two are attached to ترهقني, and the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; the yāʾ of أمري is muḍāf ilayhi, and the first object of ترهقني is the yāʾ in ترهقني.]. ﴿عُسْراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:74-74.t: ﴿فَانْطَلَقا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb, and the alif is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb for future time, containing the sense of condition. ﴿لَقِيا﴾: a past verb, and the alif is the fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿غُلاماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَقَتَلَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَقَتَلْتَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿نَفْساً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿زَكِيَّةً﴾: a naʿt (adjective). ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to زكية. ﴿نَفْسٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to the omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جِئْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نُكْراً﴾: a naʿt; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to an oath.

daas-irab:75-76.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and لم is a particle of the jussive. ﴿أَقُلْ﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm); the fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَكَ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لَنْ﴾: a particle governing the accusative. ﴿تَسْتَطِيعَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb), its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مَعِيَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to تستطيع, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿صَبْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle governing the jussive. ﴿سَأَلْتُكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; it is in the position of the jussive, and the clause is initial. ﴿عَنْ شَيْءٍ﴾: the two are attached to سألت. ﴿بَعْدَها﴾: an adverb of time attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of شيء, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; لا is prohibitive, governing the jussive. ﴿تُصاحِبْنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive لا; its fāʿil is latent, the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿بَلَغْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a preposition. ﴿لَدُنِّي﴾: an adverb in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the two are attached to بلغت, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عُذْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:77-78.t: ﴿فَانْطَلَقا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿أَتَيا﴾: a past verb, and the alif is its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَهْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اسْتَطْعَما﴾: a past verb, and the alif is its fāʿil. ﴿أَهْلَها﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to إذا. ﴿فَأَبَوْا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a ḍamma implied on the dropped alif; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a particle governing the accusative. ﴿يُضَيِّفُوهُما﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; an and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar, are in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَوَجَدا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb, and the alif is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيها﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to وجدا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جِداراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of جدار. ﴿أَنْ يَنْقَضَّ﴾: أن is a particle governing the accusative, and an imperfect verb in the accusative, its fāʿil latent; the first maṣdar [Translator's note: so in the source («المصدر الأول»), probably for «المصدر المؤول», the interpreted maṣdar.] is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَقامَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿شِئْتَ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَاتَّخَذْتَ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of the condition, and a past verb whose fāʿil is the tāʾ. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: the two are attached to اتخذت. ﴿أَجْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هذا فِراقُ﴾: the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh) and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and فراق is khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَيْنِي﴾: an adverb of place attached to فراق, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبَيْنِكَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an adverb of place conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿سَأُنَبِّئُكَ﴾: the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil latent. ﴿بِتَأْوِيلِ﴾: the two are attached to أنبئك; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿لَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ﴾: لم is a particle governing the jussive, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: the two are attached to تستطع. ﴿صَبْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:79-81.t: ﴿أَمَّا﴾: a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl). ﴿السَّفِينَةُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فَكانَتْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine, and its noun is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of السفينة. ﴿لِمَساكِينَ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar of كانت. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of مساكين. ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾: the two are attached to يعملون. ﴿فَأَرَدْتُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a particle governing the accusative. ﴿أَعِيبَها﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb); its fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); an and what follows it are in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of أردت. ﴿وَكانَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an incomplete past verb. ﴿وَراءَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿مَلِكٌ﴾: the postponed noun of كان. ﴿يَأْخُذُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative, its fāʿil latent; the clause is a naʿt of ملك. ﴿كُلَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سَفِينَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿غَصْباً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿وَأَمَّا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أما is a particle of condition and detailing. ﴿الْغُلامُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَكانَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿كان﴾: an incomplete past verb. ﴿أَبَواهُ﴾: its noun, nominative by the alif because it is dual, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُؤْمِنَيْنِ﴾: the khabar of كان, accusative by the yāʾ because it is dual; the clause is the khabar. ﴿فَخَشِينا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and خشينا is a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a particle governing the accusative. ﴿يُرْهِقَهُما﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative; the fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿طُغْياناً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَكُفْراً﴾: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to طغيانا. ﴿فَأَرَدْنا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a particle governing the accusative. ﴿يُبْدِلَهُما﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَبُّهُما﴾: fāʿil, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation; an and what follows it are mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَيْراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: the two are attached to خيرا. ﴿زَكاةً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَأَقْرَبَ﴾: conjoined to خيرا. ﴿رُحْماً﴾: tamyīz.

daas-irab:82-83.t: ﴿وَأَمَّا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أما is a conditional particle. ﴿الْجِدارُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فَكانَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb;
